name: Orzo Pasta Salad
subtitle: Yummy in Summer!
notes: This is a really refreshing, light and delicious salad you can munch on for a meal or two–but don’t double it unless you’ve got more than a couple of people eating it. It can be eaten cold or warm.

items: 1 cup (uncooked) orzo pasta–whole wheat if you can find it
1–2 cups fresh sweet corn (3–4 ears), cut off the cob
1–2 cups rotisserie chicken, shredded or cut into small pieces
Small bundle of fresh dill, minced
Small bundle of green onions, sliced
Lemon juice, and a little fancy balsamic vinegar if you have some sitting in your pantry

steps.title: Cook the orzo
steps.body: Cook **1 cup (uncooked) orzo pasta**, whole wheat if you can find it, just until al dente.

steps.title: Sauté the corn
steps.body: In a separate pan, sauté olive oil and **1–2 cups fresh sweet corn (3–4 ears)**, cut off the cob, and **2 cloves garlic**, minced, just until the corn turns bright.

steps.title: Prep the add-ins
steps.body: Meanwhile, prepare the following to toss into the pasta and corn mixture: **1–2 cups rotisserie chicken**, shredded or cut into small pieces; **1–2 cups chopped cucumber**; **1–2 cups baby spinach**; small bundle of fresh dill, minced; small bundle of green onions, sliced; and crumbled goat cheese (optional).

steps.title: Toss and dress
steps.body: Toss the add-ins into the pasta and corn mixture, then dress to taste with olive oil, lemon juice and a little fancy balsamic vinegar if you have some sitting in your pantry, salt and pepper.
